name: Bakery-Style Chocolate Chip Cookies
desc: Thick chocolate chip cookies with chopped dark chocolate and an overnight chill for chewy centers.

source.title: Bakery-Style Chocolate Chip Cookies
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 1/4 tsp fine salt (3/4 tsp if using unsalted butter)
1 tsp honey or light corn syrup

steps: Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt in a medium bowl.
In a large bowl, stir the butter, both sugars and the vanilla with a wide spatula about 2 min, until smooth and like damp sand. Do not whip it pale.
Mix in the honey, then the egg.
Add the dry mix and stir until most of the flour is absorbed, then fold in the chocolate.
Press plastic wrap onto the dough and refrigerate 8-24 hr (4 hr minimum).
Heat the oven to 350°F and line two baking sheets with parchment. If the dough is too firm to scoop, let it sit 20-30 min.
Scoop 16 balls of about 56g, roll them smooth, and space them 3 in apart, 6 per sheet.
Bake 9-11 min, until puffed and golden at the edges but still soft in the middle.
Cool on the pan 2 min, then move to a rack. Add flaky salt while warm.
tips: Use softened salted butter, not brown butter, and chopped bar chocolate for melty pools.
For thicker cookies, cut the soda to 1/2 tsp or add 18g more flour. For bigger ones, make 13 at 2.5 oz and bake 2 min longer.
Maple syrup cannot replace the honey. With light brown sugar, use 200g light brown plus 45g granulated.
Dough balls freeze 3 months. Baked cookies keep 5 days airtight.

references.title: The BEST Chocolate Chip Cookies (Bakery Style)
references.usedFor: full measured recipe, parchment-lined sheets, 6 per sheet, yield of 16
